record.question: Consider the lilies _____________ they grow. Complete the sentence by supplying appropriate connecting word.
record.explanation: Answer D: how. “How they grow” completes “Consider ... how they grow” and expresses the manner in which the lilies grow. Independent check: “Consider how they grow” takes the manner clause introduced by “how.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
